snippet.title: Miss Rosen's Wowtastic! Marching Band Steam Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The band is in town, and it’s time for some fun! Join Miss Rosen — a clockwork majorette escaped from her music box — and Dunno the Dinosaur as they travel the world solving luggage-packing puzzles and fighting to prevent the next mass extinction. Coming soon to Steam — now in 4K!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4634090
